title: SIYAYO Academy — Specialized Module Governance Registry
publication_status: Documentation branch jaguar/module-governance-registry-20261024; docs-only, no merge to main; read source_commit for audited code reference
contract_rule: Module code, name, HTML selector, event, data source, owner and update invariants must be verified before reuse. Visual module ≠ evaluation authority.

modules.name: Experience Header
modules.how_to_record: Presentation memory may retain navigation state; no evaluation credit
modules.how_to_check: Ensure experience exists and localized text is grounded
modules.update_rules: Re-render on Experience or language change

modules.name: Circumstance Strip
modules.how_to_show: Render five contextual cards with localized labels
modules.how_to_check: Unknown circumstance keys must not be fabricated
modules.update_rules: Re-render on Experience or language change
modules.portability: Reusable if source keys/translation dictionary provided

modules.name: Dependency Focus
modules.how_to_do: Resolve canonical dependency structure matching Experience/QW/language
modules.how_to_record: Read-only diagram; interaction observer may log exploration, not Evidence
modules.how_to_check: Validate referenced structure and tokens; never infer missing syntax
modules.update_rules: Recompute on grounded selection, redraw connectors after geometry/preview changes
modules.portability: Portable ONLY with canonical dependency structures, diagram renderer, connector view, CSS
modules.visual_contract: Centered token diagram with semantic links; preserve readable arrows

modules.name: Dependency Head Probe
modules.how_to_do: Present candidates and determine selected syntactic head
modules.how_to_record: Free observation via PATITA; Attempt/Evidence only with compatible active contract
modules.how_to_check: Verify matching structure, learner, language, Experience, scope and authorized Session
modules.how_to_speak: Probe speaker via supplied speak callback
modules.update_rules: Mount or hide when metadata/scope changes; preserve qualified feedback by context
modules.warnings: HEAD IDENTIFIED in practice ≠ contract 3/3 or GREEN PASS

modules.name: Learner Identity
modules.how_to_do: Establish displayed learner identity and allow changing it
modules.how_to_record: Identity source; canonical learning identity is not display-only
modules.how_to_check: Scope any canonical evidence to exact learner
modules.update_rules: Refresh on identity change and Experience render
modules.portability: Reuse only with privacy and identity scope controls
modules.warnings: Do not carry one learner’s evidence into another learner’s view

modules.name: Pedagogical Axes / Gear Stack
modules.how_to_do: Choose visible axes; Thinking Mind Decision resolves available opportunities
modules.how_to_record: Presentation memory retains UI; canonical evaluation only on declared target via Assessment Selection
modules.how_to_show: Render active buttons and available axes; change content in adjacent panels
modules.how_to_check: No fabricated QW skills; grammar lock and contextual coherence gates
modules.how_to_speak: Changes active voice locale, but gear has no audio
modules.update_rules: Re-render current Experience; reset line offset as coded; preserve scope-owned evidence
modules.portability: Portable as UI shell; assessment selection requires canonical runtime
modules.visual_contract: Gold labels, SIYAYO dark blue, selected active states

modules.name: Living Window / Lines & Possible Responses
modules.how_to_do: Assemble three visible lines from authored Corpus and current axes
modules.how_to_record: Speech lines do NOT register evaluative responses; PATITA may observe clicks
modules.how_to_show: Render header/counter/dialogue, optional subpanels and NEXT
modules.how_to_check: VisibleAssessmentBoundary labels corpus-only; missing authored variants show authoring gap
modules.update_rules: Rebuild on relevant selection; lineOffset reset for most navigation actions
modules.portability: Portable corpus reader with separate authoring and evaluation layers
modules.visual_contract: Dark center-aligned sentence cards; 03/03 is dialogue count
modules.warnings: NEXT-09 is CHILD of LIVE-07; not an independent parent at same DOM level

modules.name: Assessment Probes
modules.how_to_do: Specialized question/choice probes for WHICH WHAT WHERE WHY
modules.how_to_record: Canonical Attempt/Evidence with authorized target only
modules.how_to_show: Dynamically mount separate probe panels; WHICH panel is before .experience-grid, not within LIVE-07
modules.how_to_check: Validate declared assessment target, scope, result, compatible session and pass contract
modules.how_to_speak: Independent question-card TTS and answer-row TTS
modules.update_rules: Mount/hide and refresh on active context and scope
modules.portability: Not portable as a plain visual widget without evaluation gates
modules.visual_contract: B1 speech question vs B2 separate audio & answer
modules.warnings: Never infer credit from corpus listening

modules.name: Toroidal NEXT Navigation
modules.how_to_do: Offer navigation candidate or authorized progression path
modules.how_to_record: Observations and canonical progression maintained by respective authorities
modules.how_to_check: NEXT candidate ≠ GREEN or assessment authorization
modules.update_rules: Update on Experience render, authorized progression and transfer readiness
modules.portability: Can copy visual navigation shell; cannot blindly copy canonical progression authority
modules.visual_contract: Centered dark blue panel with gold NEXT button
modules.warnings: To place above NEXT: insert before .toroidal-next within .living-window; do not confuse LIVE-07 with NEXT-09

modules.name: Learning Trail
modules.how_to_do: Project learner progress by authorized skill and scope
modules.how_to_check: Verify accepted evidence, scope and progress markers
modules.update_rules: Refresh after canonical evidence or visible context updates
modules.portability: Portable read-only with corresponding canonical sources

modules.name: Word Path
modules.how_to_check: No witness => no accepted label; never invent answer text
modules.update_rules: Refresh with Trail and scope changes
modules.portability: Portable ONLY alongside canonical evidence reader

modules.name: PATITA Interaction Ledger
modules.how_to_do: Observe interaction intents and visible outcomes
modules.how_to_record: Local bounded ledger, max 500 records; observational only
modules.how_to_show: Render recent PATITA interactions within expandable module
modules.how_to_check: Classify UI outcomes, NOT canonical evaluator
modules.portability: Portable if privacy model and event selectors adapted
modules.warnings: PATITA is NEVER sole authority for Attempt, Evidence, GREEN

modules.how_to_do: Project SIYAYO-authoring reference with H14.13 core coherence rules

modules.how_to_show: Five-function panel with two contextual cards; default hidden; opt-in ?h14_14=preview
modules.how_to_check: H14.13 projectSingle verifies provenance, status, authoring compatibility and lack of assessment authority
modules.how_to_speak: H14.19 speech-window work is specialized; verify precise behavior before adopting in another site

modules.name: Corpus Speech Card
modules.how_to_do: Select authored text to read aloud
modules.how_to_record: Not an assessment answer; PATITA may observe click
modules.how_to_show: Full-card speech button; centered paragraph + edge icon
modules.how_to_check: VisibleAssessmentBoundary; authoring-gap item is not clickable speech

modules.visual_contract: Dark background; centered semibold body; gold bold target; SVG-mask gold speaker; CURRENT Explorer speaker at LEFT via .living-line b {left:13px;right:auto}; RIGHT is a proposed placement variant

modules.name: Assessment Question Speech Card
data_sources: Authorized probe questions and localized specifications
modules.how_to_record: Question audio is not answer selection
modules.how_to_show: Question button with integrated speaker icon and centered text
modules.how_to_check: Assessment/scope checked independently; question listen alone no evidence
modules.portability: Portable only after separating visual speech from assessment semantics
modules.visual_contract: Gold speaker inside one card; target text gold bold

modules.name: Assessment Response Row
modules.how_to_do: Separate listening action from answer selection
modules.how_to_record: Answer selection may submit authorized Attempt only through evaluative boundary
modules.how_to_show: Two independent controls: speaker cell + response button, centered text
modules.how_to_check: Verify no Answer submission on audio click; authority gate must validate selection
modules.how_to_speak: Independent audio button for localized response
modules.update_rules: Remount/redraw on scoped assessment and language changes
modules.portability: Portable as two-button presentation; never copy assessment submission blindly
modules.visual_contract: Two-cell dark panel; CSS presently places speech icon in LEFT column

modules.name: Responsive Stage — Auto / Portrait / Landscape
consumers: any target page adopting common shell
modules.how_to_do: Constrain preview viewport on desktop; Auto uses actual responsive width
modules.how_to_record: Persist preview mode in localStorage ONLY; no pedagogical state
modules.how_to_show: css/siyayo-responsive-stage.css applies toolbar and widths; JS toggles data-preview, active class and aria-pressed
modules.how_to_check: Whitelist auto/portrait/landscape; on touch-first force AUTO; verify page-specific container queries
modules.update_rules: On mode switch dispatch custom event; page-specific layout may listen for redraw
modules.portability: HIGH — copy two shared files, HTML shell and scoped page CSS; preserve contract
modules.visual_contract: Portrait=430px; Landscape=844px; Auto=no width cap; toolbar hidden for coarse-pointer touch
modules.warnings: Developer preview is NOT physical device emulation; CSS container/media rules must be adapted for the new page

modules.name: XESPIRITO — Functional Diagnosis
modules.status: additional module; alias not in 01–13 numbering
modules.how_to_record: No evidence writes in static diagnosis itself
modules.how_to_check: Use functional grammar diagnosis, not invented evaluator

placement_rules.LIVE-07: The parent `.living-window` contains `#livingLines`, choice/contrast panels, `.line-controls`, `#assessmentAdoptionControls`, then `.toroidal-next`.
placement_rules.above_NEXT-09: Insert a new panel as a child of `.living-window` before `.toroidal-next`. Ensure no accidental assessment credit and preserve existing subpanel sequence.
placement_rules.FUNC-13: Independent `.h14-specialized-preview` after `.experience-grid` and before `#learningTrailWordPathModule`; default hidden.
placement_rules.RS-01: The toolbar sits before `.stage-viewport`, which wraps the main page content.
